preview: Receiving a package is not always easy, even when people try to plan ahead. In this episode, you’ll hear about the challenges people face and what to consider when a package is on its way.
comment_1: Listen for the different views these three people have about paying for another delivery.
comment_2: The question is whether someone should pay extra when they miss a delivery. Now, three people will share their thoughts.
comment_3: So why does the same issue look so different to different people? It may depend on what each person can choose and what feels fair to them. Keep that question in mind as you listen to the final thoughts.
